feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 26 October 2026 6:38am
items.description:
##Today##

A band of rain will arrive in the morning, turning heavy at times. This will clear early afternoon to leave a dry spell, although drizzle will likely continue over higher ground. Further rain will arrive overnight, as winds reach gale to severe force later in the day and through the night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

7-12, 20 on hills


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

SW 15-20, soon backing SE 25-30, then veering S or SSW early afternoon. Increasing 30-40 (gusts 45-55) through the evening, peaking at 40-45 (gusts 50-60, up to 65 in exposed spots) for a time early night, then veering SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Very deep low will bring gales and severe gales later in the day and overnight. Coastal overtopping at high tide (approx. 11:00 & 23:25) (See warnings for further detail/updates: https://www.gov.im/weather/).


##Tomorrow##

Sunny intervals and windy. A few isolated showers are possible during the afternoon and evening, becoming more widespread for a time overnight.


##Temperature##

##Comments##
